# Check 2: model fits

```{r fits-idx, fig.height = 4}
ss3plot_indices(idx, fit = ss3_indices(ss3simple, what = "exp"))
```

```{r fits-comps, fig.height = 5}
ss3plot_comps(lfd, fit = ss3_lencomp(ss3simple, what = "exp"), by = "unit")
```

> **Check 2: fits.** The fitted index should follow the trend of each index; systematic misfits at the start or
> end of a series, or an index fitted only where it agrees with another, point to conflicts between data
> sources. Pooled compositions should be fitted without systematic misfit of the small or large bins.
